build_LBSModule_pose: build a python module to pose 3D mesh vertices using LBSModule with motion parameters and scale
build_LBSModule_unpose: build a python module to unpose skinned mesh vertices back to rest pose using LBSModule
build_LinearBlendSkinning_skinning: build a python module to apply linear blend skinning to mesh vertices given skeleton states
build_solve_skeleton_state: build a python module to compute skeleton joint states from pose parameters using solve_skeleton_state
build_load_momentum_cfg: build a python module to parse a momentum LBS config text file and return transform matrices and limits
